review:
Dusk Princess is a 6-reel, 5-row cluster slot from Hacksaw Gaming with a night-sky, gem-filled look. It uses Super Cascades: when a win lands, every regular symbol of that type is removed from the grid, not just the winning ones, and new symbols drop in.

Winning symbols also fill the Blessing Bar beside the grid. The first fill needs an 8-symbol win, and each later fill needs two more symbols. When full, it drops wilds carrying a multiplier that applies to connected wins. Each activation can add another wild or raise the multiplier with additive values from 1x up to 500x. Hacksaw lists a 10,000x max win, reachable in all game modes. It suits fans of cascading cluster games with a building meter.
